name: Mountain Plover
rangeDescription: Great plains of western canada to southwestern usa; winters to northern mexico
description: Medium-sized, plain buffy plover that favors flat open areas with little or no vegetation. Plain whitish underparts with no breast band.

name: Gray-olive Greenbul
rangeDescription: Southern kenya to tanzania, zambia, southern democratic republic of the congo, malawi, and mozambique
description: Fairly small and typically plain greenbul. The pale bill and legs are unusual.

name: Maui Parrotbill
rangeDescription: Maui (ohia montane forest on east slopes of haleakala crater)
description: A very rare Hawaiian honeycreeper of high elevation wet forests on eastern Maui. The thick, parrotlike bill used to tear and crush stems in search of insects and larvae is diagnostic.

name: Canvasback
rangeDescription: Breeds north america from northern alaska and western canada southward through northern california, southern colorado, and minnesota (usa); winters to central mexico
description: Attractive duck with distinctive triangular head; forehead slopes seamlessly into the long bill. Males are white-bodied with black chest, reddish-brown head, and red eye.

name: New Guinea Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of new guinea
description: A huge raptor of lowland and montane forest. Note long legs, pale belly, dark back and hint of a crest at the back of the head.

name: White-throated Redstart
rangeDescription: Nepal to southern tibet and west-central china; winters to myanmar
description: Well-named; both the male and female have a white throat, as well as a long white wing stripe, a flashing orange rump, and a dark tail. The male has a dark gray hood, a black face, and a deep orange belly.

name: West African Pied Hornbill
rangeDescription: Senegambia to just east of niger river
description: A small though long-tailed hornbill that is frequently encountered as it flies singly or in groups over the canopy, between forest gaps, and over road cuts. Distinctive, with a bright white belly and a black head, body, wings, and tail, giving it a bicolored appearance.

name: Bruce's Green-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Savanna of sub-saharan africa, southwestern arabia, and socotra
description: A chunky, medium-sized pigeon that has a green back, a gray head, and a yellow belly. Flight is fast and direct.

name: Gray-hooded Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (espírito santo) to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Small flycatcher that is largely olive above and cinnamon below with a gray head. The bill is two-toned with a pale base.

name: Tibetan Lark
rangeDescription: Tibetan plateau from northwestern india to central china
description: Huge bulky lark with a sharp, slightly decurved bill. Pale brown above and off-white below, with a pale brow stripe, distinct brownish ear patch, and a black mark on the neck near the shoulder.

name: Inca Tern
rangeDescription: Islands off peru and chile; ranges rarely north to ecuador
description: Beautiful and distinctive dark tern of the Humboldt Current. Found along rocky coasts and at harbors and piers where it is often confiding; less often found at sandy beaches and river mouths.

name: Buff-browed Chachalaca
rangeDescription: Northeastern brazil south of the amazon river (pará to piauí and northern goiás)
description: Small chachalaca, brown overall with a pale buff eyebrow. Found in edge habitats, thickets, and young second-growth forests, even at the edge of urban areas.

name: Yellow-fronted Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Eastern and southeastern brazil to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Multicolored, gregarious medium-sized woodpecker. Note black wings, tail, and mask, yellow forehead and eyering, white rump, and red belly bordered with dark bars.

name: Scarlet-crowned Barbet
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to eastern peru and western amazonian brazil (east to rio negro)
description: Fairly common in riverine and varzea forest of western Amazonia. A fairly large barbet with typical stout bill.

name: Sula Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Banggai and sula islands (off eastern sulawesi)
description: A large, long-tailed, slate-colored dove with a conspicuous white face. Also note the red eye-ring and the metallic green shawl on the sides of the neck.

name: Atlantic Plain-Xenops
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (north to southern bahia) to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Active small bird of humid tropical forest. Usually found singly, often moving with mixed-species feeding flocks.

name: Mindoro Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: West-central philippines (mindoro, libagao, and tablas)
description: Sleek but sturdy gray bird with fierce pale eyes, endemic to the west-central Philippine islands of Mindoro, Libagao, and Tablas. Male is uniform overall, but darker on the tail, wingtips, and between the eye and bill.

name: Flame-throated Warbler
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Stunning warbler with bright orange throat, otherwise gray with black back. Sexes alike, juveniles duller.

name: Slender-billed Parakeet
rangeDescription: Lowlands of chile (aconcagua to northern aysén and chiloé island)
description: Fairly common, but nomadic in the Lake District region of Chile. Found in farmland with forest patches, hedges, and scattered tall trees; less of a forest bird than the smaller and duller Austral Parakeet, although the two species rarely if ever mix together.

name: Smew
rangeDescription: Northern eurasia; winters to north africa, india, and eastern china
description: Generally uncommon and fairly local small diving duck. Frequents lakes, reservoirs, and rivers.
